benchmark: No NZ benchmark place lies in this region. Region-relevant checks: Symbio stays review; vehicle/operator candidates (Eden Whale Watching, Jervis Bay Dolphin and Whale Watching Cruises, Shellharbour Wild Whale Watching, BIGWAVE Skydive) rejected in favour of the place; once-a-week or annual events (Kiama Seaside Markets, Blessing of the Fleet, Bermagui Sculpture on the Edge, Illawarra Grevillea Park) rejected; Booderee and the bay are one place (Booderee kept as a spot of Jervis Bay).
method_note: Lowest kept scores are 0 views with 1 counted source (many beaches, walks and museums), so every left-out candidate with any views counts as stronger; all are listed with their concrete reason.
